author: Egopez
quote: GTA VI looks like an overhyped disappointment disguised as a masterpiece. The graphics are impressive, but that means nothing if the gameplay feels repetitive and the missions lack originality. Rockstar seems more interested in selling nostalgia than delivering something genuinely innovative. The world may be huge, but size doesn't guarantee quality. After years of waiting, this game risks being another overpriced product benefiting from its legendary name rather than its actual merits

author: Egopez
quote:
This game is incredibly frustrating. It's soulless, with tons of NPCs and vast landscapes—but what's the point? You're constantly left wondering what to do. The story never grabs you. I ended up uninstalling it after eight hours. It was maddening. There are too many other games to spend time trying to figure out what to do in Crimson Desert. Next.
I give it a 6 for the graphics, which are really good, but nothing else
